description: Fetch one OEIS entry by A-number. Returns the name, data-line terms, offset, keywords, author, dates, and the sections: comments, formulas (recurrences and generating functions), examples, programs (Maple, Mathematica, PARI, Python, …), references, links, cross-references, and extensions. When the sections together exceed 24,000 characters of serialized JSON, the core fields come back with a section outline instead; call again with sections to pick what to read. A selection past 100,000 bytes comes back in parts cut between items: pass nextFromItem as fromItem, with the same sections, for the next part.

aNumber.description: OEIS A-number, e.g. "A000045"; oeis_identify_sequence and oeis_search_sequences return them. Also accepts "a000045", "A45", "45", and an oeis.org sequence URL; all normalize to the zero-padded form. Legacy M/N book numbers (e.g. "M1459") are not A-numbers: find them with oeis_search_sequences.

fromItem.description: Where to resume a cut selection: the previous response's nextFromItem, passed unchanged with the same sections. The selected sections before fromItem.section are left out. Omit to start at the beginning.

index.description: 0-based position of the item within its section.

sections.description: Sections to return with the core fields, e.g. ["formulas", "programs"]. A selection past the 100,000-byte response budget is cut between items; fromItem continues it. Omit (or pass []) for the full entry, or the core fields plus an outline when the entry is large.

name: oeis_get_sequence

author.description: Author line as OEIS records it; absent when the entry has none.

bFileUrl.description: URL of the entry's b-file of extended terms; oeis_get_terms reads it.

comments.description: Comment lines, one element per upstream line, written by OEIS contributors. Present on a full entry or when selected; a cut selection carries only this part's lines.

created.description: When the entry was created, ISO 8601 with offset.

crossReferences.description: Cross-reference lines naming related A-numbers, one element per upstream line, written by OEIS contributors. Present on a full entry or when selected; a cut selection carries only this part's lines.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `sequence_not_found`: No OEIS entry exists for the requested A-number. `from_item_not_selected`: fromItem is given without sections, or names a section that sections does not select. `pacer_shed`: The oeis.org request queue would exceed its wait budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: oeis.org answered HTTP 429 Too Many Requests and retries within the call did not clear it. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

examples.description: Example lines; whitespace matters for triangles and tables, one element per upstream line, written by OEIS contributors. Present on a full entry or when selected; a cut selection carries only this part's lines.

extensions.description: Extension lines: who added terms or corrections, and when, one element per upstream line, written by OEIS contributors. Present on a full entry or when selected; a cut selection carries only this part's lines.

firstIndex.description: The index n of the first term (the first number of offset); absent with offset.

formulas.description: Formula lines: recurrences, generating functions, closed forms, one element per upstream line, written by OEIS contributors. Present on a full entry or when selected; a cut selection carries only this part's lines.

keywords.description: Keyword flags such as nonn, core, tabl; oeis_list_reference topic keywords decodes them.

kind.description: full: every section, or the selected ones (a selection past the 100,000-byte response budget is cut between items, and nextFromItem continues it). outline: the entry is too large, so sections lists the sections to request by name.

legacyIds.description: Legacy book numbers, e.g. ["M0692", "N0256"]; absent on entries that have none.

links.description: Link lines. Present on a full entry or when selected; a cut selection carries only this part's lines.

text.description: The link line with HTML removed.

urls.description: Absolute URL of every link on the line.

modified.description: When the entry was last edited, ISO 8601 with offset.

name.description: Sequence name, written by OEIS contributors.

nextFromItem.description: Present when the selection was cut at the 100,000-byte response budget: the first item left out. Pass it unchanged as fromItem, with the same sections, to continue.

index.description: 0-based position of the item within its section.

notice.description: Guidance: the entry is withdrawn (dead) or its A-number reserved or recycled; where a cut selection stopped and the call that continues it; or that fromItem lies past the end of its section.

offset.description: Offset "i,p": i is the index n of the first term, p the 1-based position of the first term with |a(n)| > 1. Absent on a reserved or recycled A-number (keyword allocated or recycled).

outlineNotice.description: Outline only: how to request sections, and how a large selection continues.

programs.description: Programs that compute the terms. Present on a full entry or when selected; a cut selection carries only this part's blocks.

code.description: Program text, one upstream line per line.

language.description: Language, e.g. Maple, Mathematica, PARI, Python; absent when untagged.

referenceCount.description: How many OEIS entries mention this A-number, the entry itself included.

references.description: Reference lines (books and papers), one element per upstream line, written by OEIS contributors. Present on a full entry or when selected; a cut selection carries only this part's lines.

sections.description: Outline only: the sections of the entry, largest first.

items.description: One section of the entry and its size.

bytes.description: Size of the section as serialized JSON, counted in characters (UTF-16 code units, equal to bytes for ASCII text): the unit of the 24,000 outline budget.

name.description: Section name to pass in sections.

terms.description: Data-line terms as exact decimal strings, signs kept; the first is a(firstIndex).

url.description: Sequence page on oeis.org; cite it wherever the entry is reused.

title: Get OEIS Sequence
